newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says forex rates decided by supply/demand.
newsitem.headline: MOF says forex rates decided by supply/demand.

text.p: Foreign exchange rates are decided by the supply and demand conditions within the market, Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.
Mitsuzuka declined to comment on short-term movements in the currency market when asked whether Japan will take action in the market if the dollar rises above 120 yen.
"It is the basic rule for the finance minister not to comment on short-term movements of the market," Mitsuzuka said.
"Currency rates reflect economic fundamentals and speculation and are decided by the supply and demand (conditions) of the market," he added.

The dollar edged higher against the yen in early Tokyo trade on Tuesday on a news agency report that Eisuke Sakakibara, Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs, denied that Japan had warned it would take decisive action if the dollar rose above 120 yen.
